transcript.text:
I'll start by looking at the columns in your table. That will show whether it has what a prediction needs.

Pick the option that fits best. If you have a record of past upgrades, such as a column or file showing who moved to premium and when, tell me. With that I could build a proper upgrade prediction.

choices.title: Find customers who look like current premium ones
choices.what: Use the plan column to learn what premium customers have in common (spend, tenure, tickets, segment), then score customers on other plans by how closely they match. This shows who resembles premium customers, not who has actually upgraded before.

choices.title: Compare premium and non-premium customers
choices.what: Show how customers on each plan differ in spend, tenure, support tickets, segment and city. You can use this to choose trial targets yourself.

choices.title: Find new customer groups to target
choices.what: Group customers by similar behavior and spend, so you can see which groups to try a premium trial on first.

transcript.text:
I've started the project. It will use the `plan` column to learn what current premium customers have in common. That means spend, tenure, support tickets, segment and city. It will then score customers on other plans by how closely they match.

- **What the scores mean:** A high score means a customer looks like your premium customers. It doesn't mean they're likely to upgrade, because the table has no record of past upgrades. Treat the list as a good place to start a trial, not a forecast.
- **Check the result:** Send the trial to a small group first and see how many take it up. That will show how well the scores work.
- **Columns to ignore:** `churned_next_month` is about leaving, so it shouldn't feed into this model. `customer_id` is only a label.
transcript.text_fa:
پروژه را شروع کرده‌ام. از ستون `plan` استفاده می‌کند تا یاد بگیرد مشتری‌های premium فعلی چه چیزهای مشترکی دارند. یعنی خرج، مدت عضویت، تیکت‌های پشتیبانی، بخش مشتری و شهر. بعد به مشتری‌های پلن‌های دیگر بر اساس میزان شباهتشان امتیاز می‌دهد.

- **معنی امتیازها:** امتیاز بالا یعنی مشتری شبیه مشتری‌های premium شماست. معنی‌اش این نیست که احتمال ارتقایش زیاد است، چون جدول هیچ سابقه‌ای از ارتقاهای گذشته ندارد. لیست را یک نقطه‌ی خوب برای شروع آزمایشی در نظر بگیرید، نه یک پیش‌بینی.
- **بررسی نتیجه:** اول آزمایشی را برای یک گروه کوچک بفرستید و ببینید چند نفر قبولش می‌کنند. این نشان می‌دهد امتیازها چقدر خوب کار می‌کنند.
- **ستون‌هایی که باید نادیده گرفته شوند:** `churned_next_month` درباره‌ی رفتن مشتری است، پس نباید وارد این مدل شود. `customer_id` فقط یک برچسب است.
